task: Task 1 – convert three v216 scope-review findings into real live mock-card corrections
scope: Three of the 194 legacy A2 Chemistry mock cards documented by the v216 audit. Original core data and historic audits remain immutable; patches are applied in memory when app.js loads the cards.

changes.fix: Replace multi-part gradient/intercept prompt with the missing single-fact requirement that T be in kelvin; separately retained v210 gradient/intercept flashcards.
Relabel CIP-ranking card as E/Z isomerism (AQA 3.3.1.3) rather than optical isomerism; retain original correct priority explanation.

State unequal gaseous mole coefficients explicitly and ask only which side is favoured; an existing AS card covers the equal-moles exception and v210 separately tests that Kp stays constant at constant temperature.

limitations: Scope fixes only. Does not certify all mock flashcards, the AQA syllabus, all examiner-equivalent responses, student mastery, or all historic 2015–2026 paper questions.
remaining: Audit original AS Chemistry and other supplement card content against each examinable requirement.
Check original exam-question marking, alternative methods and ECF.
